mapper.insert: INSERT INTO att01_work_policy ( att01_work_policy_id, att01_company_id, att01_start_date, att01_work_start_time, att01_work_end_time, att01_break_minutes, att01_overtime_minutes, att01_start_grace_after_minutes, att01_end_grace_before_minutes, att01_end_grace_after_minutes, att01_use_yn, att01_pm_work_start_time, att01_pm_work_end_time ) VALUES ( #{workPolicyId}, #{companyId}, #{req.startDate}, #{req.workStartTime}, #{req.workEndTime}, #{req.breakMinutes}, #{req.overtimeMinutes}, #{req.startGraceAfterMinutes}, #{req.endGraceBeforeMinutes}, #{req.endGraceAfterMinutes}, CASE WHEN COALESCE(#{req.useYn}, false) THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END, #{req.pmWorkStartTime}, #{req.pmWorkEndTime} )
